Version information

Current version first. Open any version to see exactly what changed.

  • Removed the extra helper copy under the locked Logo watermark and Repeat watermark controls.
  • Kept both Pro controls frozen for Free accounts without the extra text below them.
  • Matched the final printed Payment receipt PAID stamp geometry to the receipt modal.
  • Made the final printed PAID stamp overlap RM12.90 the same way as the modal instead of sitting separately beside it.
  • Made Logo watermark an exclusive watermark mode so Text or Signature no longer renders underneath and overlaps the logo.
  • Removed Logo from the main Watermark type selector; Text and Signature remain there while Logo uses its dedicated Pro checkbox and settings.
  • Made Logo watermark and Repeat watermark mutually exclusive to avoid two watermark modes fighting for the same render pass.
  • Prebuilt the dedicated Logo settings in the source markup so they no longer flash open during first load.
  • For Free accounts, Logo watermark is hard-disabled, unchecked and its settings stay closed and non-interactive.
  • Made Login/Register Top Users use the full modal body instead of leaving a large dead area below the visible rows.
  • Removed the Top Users list height cap inside the auth modal so all 30 users scroll inside the full available shell on desktop and mobile.
  • Restored the final Payment receipt print layout with the complete receipt hierarchy, dashed separators, discount, paid stamp and readable A4 typography.
  • Placed the Login/Register title, tabs and desktop content into explicit grid rows so Register no longer creates a different top gap from Login.
  • Kept the mobile bottom navigation white and preserved the V107 raw-script leak repair.
  • Removed the malformed receipt-print string that leaked raw JavaScript into the page.
  • Stopped older patch scripts from overwriting the current Version information card.
  • Forced every Pro-plan tick, including Everything in Free, to use the same blue tick.
  • Locked Login/Register Support and Top Users to one shared responsive shell height, including no-data states.
  • Kept the mobile bottom navigation white.
  • Forced Everything in Free to use the same blue Pro tick after legacy overrides.
  • Restored the mobile bottom navigation to white.
  • Attempted to match Login/Register Top Users modal height to Support.
  • Attempted to make Everything in Free blue, change the mobile nav to black and equalize Login/Register modal heights.
  • The inherited late styles still overrode two of those visual changes, which Version 106 corrects.
  • Moved Watermark Tools select arrows to a consistent inset.
  • Unified username and frozen @ typography.
  • Rebalanced the 16:9 Kemajuan muat turun report.
  • Changed Logo watermark from a simple toggle into a complete dedicated Pro control group with its own logo picker, position, opacity, size and padding.
  • Logo watermark works as its own overlay instead of hijacking the Text / Signature selector.
  • Repaired username line boxes and the 16:9 Kemajuan muat turun export layout.
  • Updated Watermark Tools messaging to recommend images for the most stable commercial workflow.
  • Explained that PNG usually stays the cleanest while JPEG and WEBP can have slight recompression.
  • Changed Logo watermark into a separate Pro checkbox above Repeat watermark.
  • Made Pro-plan ticks blue and rebalanced the Kemajuan muat turun export.
  • Removed the fixed 3-minute video-duration restriction.
  • Released the looping preview decoder before processing so mobile Chrome does not decode the same video twice.
  • Preserved source dimensions and browser-chosen MP4 encoder settings.
  • Used source frame-rate when available and rejected shortened MP4 output.
  • Restored the visible filename on every uploaded-file row while keeping the per-file × remove button.
  • Returned MP4 video watermarking with a strict maximum duration of 3 minutes per video.
  • Removed every WebM fallback from the active video path; output is MP4 only.
  • Removed the old 1080p restriction: source frame dimensions are kept, including higher-resolution input when the browser encoder supports it.
  • Used generic browser MP4 encoding instead of forcing the old H.264 baseline codec string.
  • Video bitrate was derived from source file and resolution; shortened exports were rejected.
  • Temporarily removed browser video processing from the active Watermark Tools workflow.
  • Watermark uploads accepted images only in this version.
  • Added a dedicated × button on every uploaded-file row so one file could be removed without clearing the rest.
  • Clear all removed the entire upload queue, while Reset continued to reset watermark settings only.
  • Kept the V98 layout and Pro feature-tick fixes.
  • Repaired the malformed Version information structure so current and older versions stay inside the same section on mobile.
  • Stopped silent MP4-to-WebM fallback and added an up-front compatibility check before video processing.
  • Rejected truncated output instead of offering a broken few-second result.
  • Added a clear browser-video compatibility notice for commercial use.
  • Made Pro-only feature ticks actually blue while Everything in Free remains neutral.
  • Kept Version 97 print-script leak repair.
  • Repaired the receipt print function so its HTML string closes correctly and raw JavaScript can no longer render below the For You banner.
  • Moved the V96 style and video-processing patch back outside the receipt HTML string where it belongs.
  • Preserved V96 media and UI changes for follow-up testing.
  • Rebuilt the active video encoder path around a conservative 720p/15fps canvas stream and real MediaRecorder fallback candidates instead of trusting a MIME type that merely reports support.
  • Retries WebM VP8/WebM/MP4 recorder configurations when an encoder setup is rejected.
  • Redesigned Download Progress as a light editorial 16:9 report.
  • Balanced native-select chevrons and colored Pro-only plan ticks blue while inherited Free access remains neutral.
  • Compressed the Repeat watermark section so related controls read as one group instead of separate distant cards.
  • Kept the real browser select behavior while moving the visible arrow inward from the right edge.
  • Relaxed long-video readiness waits and reduced encoder load for longer browser-decodable videos.
  • Rebuilt Download Progress as a new cohesive 16:9 dark-blue export.
  • Kept the verified badge removed from the live interface for now rather than reintroducing the broken alignment.
  • Removed the custom Details/floating dropdown behavior and restored native browser select controls for Watermark Tools.
  • Removed the dropdown force-scroll behavior that could drag the page back to a menu after it was closed.
  • Changed Reset to reset watermark settings only, preserving uploaded media and the current preview.
  • Added Clear all inside the upload box to explicitly remove all uploaded media and clear the preview.
  • Added pre-paint hiding for every legacy verified-badge surface so the removed badge cannot flash during initial load.
  • Moved Watermark Tools back toward native select controls to eliminate floating/dropdown overlap behavior.
  • Separated media clearing from normal settings reset behavior.
  • Kept long-video and mobile-layout fixes from the previous pass.
  • Rebuilt the Details-disclosure dropdown behavior so expanded lists stay inside a rounded bordered control, scroll internally when long, and are scrolled into a safe zone between the sticky header and bottom navigation.
  • Fixed clipped dropdown corners by restoring overflow clipping on the rounded outer Details box and removing conflicting legacy margin/overflow overrides.
  • Hardened long-video preview and processing: waits for real decodable frames, keeps multiple uploads, resets preview media fully, prefers source captureStream audio when available, uses periodic recorder chunks, and removes the short fixed decode timeout that rejected slower long videos.
  • Centered Remember me and registration Terms/Privacy checkboxes against their first text line consistently.
  • Kept V91 receipt print-script leak fix.
  • Fixed the raw receipt-print JavaScript text leaking into the page below the banner.
  • Escaped the nested closing script tag inside the isolated print document so the browser no longer terminates the main page script early.
  • Kept the V90 layout and behavior unchanged otherwise.
  • Removed the exact notification-detail separator between the message and Watermark Pro metadata row.
  • Removed the exact separator between Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy in Settings.
  • Made Details-disclosure tool menus expand in real document flow and automatically scroll their expanded content fully above the fixed bottom navigation.
  • Added enough mobile page clearance for an opened Details menu to be completely reachable without floating or overlapping the header/nav.
  • Kept the rest of V89 unchanged.
  • Removed the divider specifically between the notification message and its Watermark Pro sender row.
  • Removed the separator specifically between Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy in Settings.
  • Matched the Profile identity username size to Overview.
  • Kept all Watermark Tools dropdowns as non-floating Details disclosures.
  • Kept Download Progress and Supporter Card downloads at 16:9.
  • Kept receipt/nav and Top Users/Notifications parity fixes.

  • Locked the downloadable Supporter Card to a true 16:9 canvas as well.
  • Made the mobile receipt body scroll only inside the space above the fixed bottom navigation while keeping the Payment receipt header visible.
  • Automatically closes the receipt whenever navigation moves to another page.
  • Locked Top Users and Notifications to the exact same vertical panel offset on desktop and mobile.
  • Removed the verified badge from all account surfaces, Top Users, sidebar, Supporter Card preview/export and the Support feature list.

  • Applied Dropdown Lab option A to Watermark tool dropdowns.
  • Adjusted verified badge geometry and Support feature icon alignment.
  • Reduced the gap between the Account heading and identity row.

  • Kept the username-to-supporter-line gap at a fixed 4px instead of stacking inherited margins.

  • Kept every tool choice as an in-flow custom dropdown/accordion: no floating layer and no browser/OS native picker.
  • Strengthened multi-video preview and processing: wait for a decoded frame, append later uploads, reset the active preview fully, lower encoder pressure, and continue the batch if one file fails.

  • Forced usernames to lowercase and regular weight in identity surfaces; uppercase input is normalized immediately.

  • Multi-file selection now appends later uploads instead of replacing earlier files, and Process files uses the full accumulated list.
  • Video preview now waits for a decoded visual frame, reset fully clears the active preview, processing audio is no longer played through speakers, and false duration-metadata failures no longer discard otherwise complete exports.

Terms & Conditions

By creating a Watermark Pro account, you agree to use the service lawfully and only with files you are allowed to process.

Account

You are responsible for the information submitted through your account and for keeping your login details secure.

Free and Pro access

Free features may be used without a paid plan. Pro Supporter unlocks the additional features shown on the Support page while the plan is active.

Payments

Pro Supporter payments remain pending until verified and approved. Access begins after approval.

Service changes

Features, pricing, limits and availability may be updated as Watermark Pro continues to develop.

Privacy Policy

Watermark Pro uses account information only to provide account, profile, subscription and related service functions.

Account information

Information such as username and email may be stored for account access and profile features.

Files you process

Watermark processing in this prototype is performed in your browser. Do not upload files you do not have permission to use.

Public profile information

If Profile visibility is set to Public, your username, plan type, ranking and processed-file count may appear in Top Users.

Payment information

Payment reference, submitted payment time and related subscription status may be stored to support payment verification.
